scope: Own Daoist chibi UI resources on the pinned QQTang client layout

structuralAlphaInputs.purpose: Source segmented status silhouette; RGB is fully replaced

assumptions: Status-bar fixed slots visually match a needle, armor/guard and winged boot. Own images replace those visual roles; exact native inventory IDs and effects are not inferred.

assumptions.evidence: Source image captions are legible; exact path binding was not found in the four inspected inert UI modules.
Native PetInfo path binding is confirmed; its smile face is replaced by the existing original pet-card paw crop.

assumptions: Storage buttons retain normal/gray/highlight/pressed stored order; task step icons retain normal/highlight/pressed/gray order.
Task level indices retain their original order, with own gold, silver, red-crown, amethyst and rose artwork.
The practice selector uses two existing own portraits. Its two labels and native click rectangles retain their original functions.
The task detail background is rendered in original 430x532 coordinates, then cropped at the measured native raster (28,21,397,518).
Runtime NPC and reward item images are separate native resources and are not supplied by this background renderer.

forge-confirm-panel only: source alpha interior ROI(6,5,221,107) is flattened to255 to remove embedded legacy example glyph/button silhouettes; source exterior including rounded contour and pointer tail is exact. Other51 source alpha planes are exact.
TButton category/item caption engine color, forge history per-message colors, framescheme execution, btn_startForge/dlg_forgeMask exact bindings and native runtime/visual acceptance remain unknown.
Button captions and per-slot fold arrows were read directly from native rasters; original native callbacks and slot indices are retained.
The five face indices retain five distinct observed facial expressions; the mood value to index computation is not promoted to verified runtime behavior.

Each emotion has a separately generated own transparent master. Slot 1 is an own brighter material variant with the original raster extent and offset, not a claim to reproduce every original subpixel facial change.

Emotion packing uses the alpha>=8 visible bounding box plus one pixel padding; excluded host-cutout dust has alpha<8. The body alpha is retained, then premultiplied scaling and native quantization apply.
The main panel is laid out in its original 257x290 declared coordinate space and cropped at native raster box (2,2,253,287).
White dynamic name, values and skill labels keep dark jade wells; brown dynamic level text keeps an ivory surface, based on static source symbolic assignments.
Pet creature previews and inventory food icons are separate resources, not baked into this control group.
num.img contains ten separate source positions visibly numbered 0 through 9; no atlas slicing or extra separators are introduced.
Message envelope positions keep their source offsets (0,5),(0,3),(0,4); their runtime notification timing is unknown.
The command button and three blank guide bubbles have no exact path binding in the four inspected modules; they remain same-path candidates.
VIP uses the existing own crown image and newly rasterized VIP letters. Dynamic membership logic is unchanged.
Chat message foreground updates and native speaker-mask blending remain runtime behavior; exact Alpha planes alone do not establish runtime acceptance.
The four inspected inert modules have no exact literal binding for these ten source image paths.
Browser chrome is repainted by native source path. External HTML, URLs, click callbacks and live page contents are not replaced by this renderer.
Stored three-position button appearance follows the source rasters; active engine state interpretation remains unverified.
All mappings are original UI slot reinterpretations. Existing item/map motifs do not establish a world resource or numeric item binding.
The 48 clan choices have distinct own subjects; 000 stays a plain empty-looking swatch without inventing a clan identity.
c01..c06 and d01..d06 are six exact original byte aliases; matching own strips are deliberately shared.
Narrow rank strips extend the original project UI material and pip system; no old lettering or subject alpha is copied.
Medal states retain source windows and indices. Own gleam/squash candidates require visual and timing review.
Cursor arrow has nine material gleam states. Click cursor uses two separately generated extended and bent index gestures, registered in a shared logical canvas.
Native cursor hotspots, GSA loader behavior, source real-time state timing, thresholds and runtime use are not verified.
Only nine explicitly listed empty masks/progress/menu/value surfaces retain source Alpha. Original portraits, scenes, captions, item shapes and checkmark glyph Alpha are not reused.
New Daoist ceremony backgrounds have their own illustrated perspective. Original native path/canvas/offsets are retained, while live avatar placement and occlusion require user review.
The two generated officiant masters supply large/small portrait variants and the two confirmation-dialog inserts; these are derived exports, not eight new model generations.

Social alternate backgrounds are associated with their original kin-tab callbacks. Profile fields are translated by the source mask widget rect(-10,-16). Inert associations do not prove executed flow.
All constant/native callbacks, account labels, dynamic product text and addresses remain unchanged by this art renderer. Live original text is outside bitmap replacement acceptance.
All 15 loose source paths retain original format, native canvas, frame count and offsets. No old promotional captions, portraits, brand pixels or silhouette Alpha are reused.
Thirteen promotion cards are timeless own-world theme art, not evidence that a named campaign, prize, date or external URL is implemented.
Two GIFs are default player-profile illustrations, using existing own Daoist child and lotus healer masters; the original ui_getPlayerDetail sex mapping and playerInfoDlg binding are unchanged.
GIFs stay genuine one-frame opaque GIF89a with original 500ms duration, loop 0, disposal 1, background index 0 and no interlace. Own palette/compression/file length can change.
No new model generation was invoked. Native runtime loading, click targets, external campaigns and user visual acceptance remain unverified.
Exactly112 remaining native shop paths,168 original positions; existing20 shop controls are excluded.
Character banners and role labels use the shared18-entry sourceRoleId/native alias/project portrait contract; no filename identity guesses or reused placeholder role.

Text-only digits/role names, small category glyphs, promo badges, eight egg-title phases and cosmetic lucky-machine art rebuild whole-frame alpha to remove legacy glyph/person/bear silhouettes. Functional crop sizes/offsets/modes remain exact.

Source-alpha policies retain exact structural planes, including lucky bulb positions, frame glows, input fields, radio holes and dialogs; alpha-redraw rows are separate documented cosmetic exceptions.

Q币 source payment category is retained because underlying payment callbacks/URL/values are unchanged. TangB/QQ糖币 is 灵币; 酷比宝石 is 灵玉. QQTTicket variable does not override original displayed gemstone identity.
Source8 egg title and7 bulb positions retain distinct stored slots; timing, loops, active bindings, live text width and final visuals remain unverified.
Eighteen room/shop aliases are paired to sourceRoleId by exact parallel native lists; two additional PVE aliases cbz/xz are proven by direct g_RoleNameList indices10/11.

Numeric extra icon suffixes are selected from PVEBossInfo.m_iImageID, not established role IDs. Seventeen independent original UI identities are allocated at stable paths; world model/NPC bindings remain unverified.
Role busts and portraits use the existing project-approved head/hair/collar ROIs, directly derived512px from their own high-resolution masters. These are UI images, not world stand/walk motion.
Old baked character-name and Ready/Master/tab/attribute-label alpha is replaced with own lettering and surfaces; it is not inherited as ghost glyph outlines.
For generic source controls without old baked glyph-alpha, final decoded functional alpha is preserved exactly. Team-color state indices and sampled base hues are retained.
Keyboard help retains the observed original single-player controls and key meanings; its bitmap diagram is rebuilt as own UI shapes/text without changing key callbacks.
All47 loose controls retain132 declared native slots, with131 nonempty positions. Source map-filter slot1 remains empty; it is never filled as an assumed button state.

Number source positions are separately observed: itemNum0-9, num0-9 plus colon, youxibi0-9 plus bottom baseline and decimal point, room num_player0-9 plus slash, fenye slash. Unproven loader/index semantics remain unknown.
GameChat duihuakuang raw0/1/2 are top/body/tail raster slices, not a normal/hover/pressed animation family.

Structural alpha is source-exact for31 positions;100 glyph/icon/cosmetic positions replace old alpha inside each complete original stored frame. Functional crop/offset/native mode and all nonpixel bytes remain source values.
The blue uiGame input drawcolor51,113,149 at12,4,244,12 and hint words55,20,180,140 require pale paper wells. This is separate from white-caption room chat controls.
Seven loose resources are byte-identical source copies of packed resources, not proven loader aliases. Every loose destination is exported separately.
Gem14/15 samples preserve source slots with own distinct glosses; original durations, live activation, text widths and final user visuals remain unverified.

alphaNormalizations.reason: Original interior alpha embeds legacy sample confirmation text, button and close block; those are not a functional occlusion mask

operation: Own artwork is composed and text rasterized at native control dimensions, then encoded into original DIMG/TGA pixel modes or a GIF palette with original canvas/timing/disposal. Upstream model-generated artwork is recorded separately; this native build does not call image models.
